R. Q. 2 تَغَلْغَلَ : see 1, first quarter, in two places. قَدْ تَغَلْغَلْتَ يَا عَدُوَّ ٱللّٰهِ, said to the مُخَنَّث Heet, when he described a woman, as is related in a trad., is expl. as meaning Thou hast reached, in thy looking, of the beauties of this woman, a point which no looker, nor any one having close communion, nor any describer, has reached [beside thee, O enemy of God]. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also He went quickly: (K, * TA:) one says, تَغَلْغَلُوا فَمَضَوْا [They went quickly, and passed, or passed away]. (TA.) ＝
-A2- تغلغل بِالغَالِيَةِ: see 2.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
